title: GDPR Article 32 Gap Analysis
summary: Assessment of technical and organisational measures against GDPR Article 32 requirements. 4 of 7 controls are fully in place; 2 are partially implemented; 1 is not in place.
scope: All systems processing personal data in the EU

items.requirement: Pseudonymisation and encryption of personal data
items.current_state: AES-256 at rest for primary DB; TLS 1.3 in transit. No pseudonymisation in analytics tables.
items.gap_description: Analytics warehouse stores email addresses in plaintext.

items.requirement: Ongoing confidentiality, integrity, availability and resilience
Ability to restore availability and access to personal data in a timely manner
Regular testing, assessing and evaluating the effectiveness of measures
items.current_state: Annual pentest by third party; no continuous monitoring.
items.gap_description: No continuous control testing; reliance on annual pentest is insufficient for a 4,000-employee SaaS.

items.requirement: Processor obligations under Art. 28 where applicable
items.current_state: No DPA template in place for subprocessors added after Feb 2026.
